lines: d11: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Chris Noh is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d11: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d11: 🕯️ Chris Noh is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d11: What Chris kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d11: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Rosa blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d11: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
d11: 📖 LEARNED: Boiling Water (Level 1). Rolling boil for 1 minute kills most pathogens. The simplest safe water.
d11: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d11: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Chris Noh, 11 days. The mantle passes to Rosa Mendez.
d11: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Rosa Mendez, 61 — a line cook. Her hands know different work now: Iron Stomach.
d11: The village's quarrel was with Chris — and Chris is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d11: The fire knew Rosa — solid ground, earned at this fire.
d62: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Rosa Mendez is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d62: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d62: ROSA — GONE. 3 open questions closed unanswered.
d62: 🕯️ Rosa Mendez is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d62: What Rosa kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d62: "Rosa's gone." Kennedy looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Rosa." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d62: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Cuan blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d62: ★ The record corrects itself: this was never Abiu — it's Field Mustard. Benoit taught you wrong (their own memory). (The Codex marks the disagreement. You can call them out in conversation.)
d62: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d62: 📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
d62: 📖 LEARNED: Cordage (Level 1). Twist plant fibers into string. Dogbane, nettle, yucca — strong fibers are everywhere.
d62: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Land (Level 1). Eat the landscape with your eyes first: green + water + sun means food grows here. Start where those three meet.

d62: The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Rosa's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
d62: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d62: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Rosa Mendez, 62 days. The mantle passes to Cuan MacDonnell.
d62: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Cuan MacDonnell, 51 — a farmer. Their hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Green Whisper, Echo Location.
d62: The village's quarrel was with Rosa — and Rosa is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d62: At the grave, Kennedy speaks for Cuan — "Rosa trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d62: The fire knew Cuan before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

d78: 📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
d78: 📖 LEARNED: Star Navigation (Level 1). North Star is constant. Find the Big Dipper, follow the pointer stars. You always know north.
d78: 📖 LEARNED: Managing Fear (Level 1). Fear is data, not orders. Acknowledge it, then decide anyway. Courage is fear that kept going.
d78: 📖 LEARNED: Radios & Signals (Level 1). Continuity, batteries, and solder. Most dead electronics are just broken connections.
d78: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d78: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"

d78: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Pavel Dubinin, 43 — a bush pilot. His hands know different work now: Bloodhound, Static Toss, Lucky Rock.

d78: You knew Cuan — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting them, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
